Emilia: ok tiny experiment: I asked an LLM to assign each open-source model in our benchmarking sheet a 'desk persona' and now I can't stop laughing. we should adopt these for Model Costume Day. :costume:

Emilia: Prompt I used: ```Give each model a 5-word desk-persona (funny, office-friendly) and a one-line explanation. Use playful tone. Models: Falcon-7B, Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, OpenOrca, Polyglot-2.```

Rashid: share pls, I need new stickers for my laptop :joy:

Emilia: Falcon-7B: "The Witty Standup Performer" - "Cracks one-liners during code reviews and handles awkward silences."
Llama2-13B: "The Overprepared PM" - "Has slides for the slides and timelines for the timelines."
Mistral-7B: "The Coffee-Fueled Racer" - "Optimizes for short deadlines and sprint snacks."
OpenOrca: "The Friendly Intern" - "Asks lots of questions and brings baked goods to retros."
Polyglot-2: "The Polyglot Neighbor" - "Answers in weird accents and knows three ways to say 'hello'."

Lina: I feel seen as Polyglot-2 (the accent thing is true) :globe_with_meridians:

Owen: can we make paper nameplates and put them on the server racks? :server:

build-bot: @Owen Creating task: "Print Model Persona Nameplates" assigned to ops-team. Due Friday.

Rashid: new challenge: write a 1-sentence elevator pitch as the model persona. Emilia can you run the same prompt but return pitches?

Emilia: did that. sample: Falcon-7B pitch: "I make meetings fun and deliver punchlines with latency under 100ms."

Lina: vote time: which persona should get a tiny costume for Model Costume Day? React with :tada: for Falcon, :spiral_notepad: for Llama2, :coffee: for Mistral, :cookie: for OpenOrca, :earth_africa: for Polyglot.

Owen: :coffee: (Mistral needs a tiny racing helmet)

Rashid: :tada: Falcon deserves standup mic prop

Lina: :cookie: OpenOrca because baked goods = immediate votes

Emilia: build-bot, tally please

build-bot: Poll results: Falcon-7B 1, Mistral-7B 1, OpenOrca 1. Tie. Suggestion: costume relay race at Friday lunch.

Owen: relay race it is. loser has to write a model persona haiku for the next week.

Rashid: also saving the prompt + outputs to #devex for sticker ideas. thanks AI culture team. :sparkles:
